task.name: open_lid_put_spoon
task.description: Use the right arm to open rice cooker lid. Then use the left arm to pick up the white spoon and put it into the rice cooker.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the rice cooker lid.
2. Grasp the rice cooker lid with the right arm.
3. Open the rice cooker lid using the right arm.
4. Move the left arm to approach and align with the white spoon.
5. Grasp the white spoon with the left arm.
6. Move the left arm to align with the open rice cooker.
7. Release the gripper to place the white spoon into the rice cooker.
